pb-recruit.title: Recruiting desk
pb-recruit.intro: Clear rules, quoted evidence and your approval before every candidate message.
pb-recruit.privateBrief: Private sourcing note. Do not send.
pb-recruit.privacyHold: Live candidate work waits for a lawyer to confirm the privacy purpose and notice. Use fictional practice evidence or handle the work manually meanwhile.
pb-recruit.name: Candidate name
pb-recruit.resumeHint: Keep job evidence only. Mark dated work as Work: 2020-01 to 2022-12: analyst. Other dates do not count as work.
pb-recruit.experienceReceipt: Code counts the union of marked work months, without counting overlap twice. Unmarked dates remain unknown.
pb-recruit.manual: Chausar prepares the words. You send them and record what actually happened.
pb-recruit.calendarHint: Paste an ICS export or leave blank and check availability yourself. No calendar event is created.
pb-recruit.availability.not-checked: Availability was not checked. Check it yourself before sending.
pb-recruit.availability.free-in-export: No overlap in this calendar export. Confirm with the attendees.
pb-recruit.copySend: Copy the approved words into your mail or calendar and send them yourself. LinkedIn and Naukri contact is manual only.
pb-recruit.complete: Every screened candidate has a greeting or skip reason.
pb-recruit.waiting: Some candidate work needs your decision.
pb-recruit.greetOrSkip: Review the candidate, then approve a greeting or record a skip reason.
pb-recruit.batchHint: One message per candidate. Consent covers only the exact words in this work round and sends nothing.
pb-recruit.boardHint: Read official public board APIs. Installation records existing jobs silently; later checks show new matches. Pay without a clear annual range stays unverified.
pb-recruit.saveRevision: Save revision and review rules again
pb-recruit.nothingExpired: No candidate records are due for deletion.
pb-recruit.recommendation.potential_matc: Quoted evidence supports the requirements. The owner verifies suitability.
pb-recruit.recommendation.not_a_match: Quoted evidence contradicts a requirement. The owner decides what happens next.
pb-recruit.recommendation.needs_review: Evidence is missing or uncertain. Ask for clarification before deciding.
pb-recruit.question.roleTitle: Which role does the client need?
pb-recruit.suggestion.roleTitle: Name the role and the work it must deliver.
pb-recruit.question.location: Where can this work be done?
pb-recruit.suggestion.location: State the workplace or remote scope.
pb-recruit.question.payRange: What pay range has the client authorised you to share?
pb-recruit.question.hardRules: Which job requirements must every candidate meet?
pb-recruit.suggestion.hardRules: Write observable professional skills, one per line.
pb-recruit.question.mustHaves: How will each required skill be verified?
pb-recruit.suggestion.mustHaves: Skill | A relevant work sample or explicit resume quote
pb-recruit.question.exclusions: Which professional evidence would contradict the requirements?
pb-recruit.suggestion.exclusions: Use explicit professional contradictions. Missing evidence stays unknown.
pb-recruit.question.targetCompanies: Which companies are useful sourcing leads?
pb-recruit.suggestion.targetCompanies: List client-approved companies, or leave empty.
pb-recruit.question.searchWords: Which search words describe the work?
pb-recruit.suggestion.searchWords: Use the role title and confirmed professional skills.
pb-recruit.question.privacyNoticeUrl: Where can the candidate read the privacy notice?
pb-recruit.suggestion.privacyNoticeUrl: Use the client approved public privacy-notice address.
pb-recruit.question.retentionDays: How long should candidate records remain after this role closes?
pb-recruit.suggestion.retentionDays: Enter the agreed number of days, such as 90.
pb-recruit.error.REQUEST_FAILED: Could not save this work. Try again.
pb-recruit.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check the requested fields and try again.
pb-recruit.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Live candidate work waits for a lawyer to confirm the privacy purpose and notice. Use fictional practice evidence or handle the work manually meanwhile.
pb-recruit.error.PROTECTED_TRAIT: Use job-related skills and evidence only. Protected traits and proxies cannot be screening rules.
pb-recruit.error.APPROVAL_CHANGED: This work changed. Open it again and approve the current version.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_RULES_REQUIRED: Approve every current role rule first.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_SOURCE_REQUIRED: Choose a readable professional source for this client order.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_SCREEN_REQUIRED: Screen against the current approved rules first.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_PRIVACY_LINE_RE: Include the exact client privacy notice address in the first message.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_APPROVAL_REQUIR: Approve this exact draft before recording that it was sent.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_STAGE_BACKWARD: Candidate stages can only move forward.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_ROUND_PENDING: Finish the pending messages before starting another round.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_BOARD_UNAVAILAB: The public board could not be read. No subscription was installed.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_BOARD_LIMIT: Use up to three distinct public boards for a role.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_TIME_BUSY: That time overlaps the calendar export. Choose another time.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_CALENDAR_UNSUPP: This calendar needs a manual availability check.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_RETENTION_NOT_D: No records have reached the agreed deletion date.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_QUESTION_CHANGE: Answer the current role question first.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_INTAKE_INCOMPLE: Finish the role questions and professional requirements.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_VERIFICATION_RE: Write each skill as Skill | How to verify.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_NOT_FOUND: This record is not in the open business.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_ORDER_REQUIRED: Choose a current order for this client.
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_EVIDENCE_REQUIR: Record the evidence for this stage change.
pb-recruit.error.OUTREACH_BLOCKED: This person opted out, is blocked, or was forgotten. Do not contact them.
pb-recruit.minimumPay: Minimum annual pay in rupees, optional
pb-recruit.error.RECRUIT_STEP_PENDING: Finish the current candidate evidence and greetings or skip reasons first.
pb-recruit.next.greet: Approve a greeting or record a skip reason
pb-recruit.expiryDeletes: Delete these candidate records, their entire imported source conversations and files, messages, interview packs, and copied reports and shares. Other client conversations stay.
